$comment: Phase 96 provenance manifest. This file is the EXPERIMENT SPECIFICATION, written before the run. probe.ts exports the same values as code constants and phase96-transfer-experiment.test.ts asserts manifest<->code agreement, so any silent drift in the harness fails the suite rather than going unnoticed. It is not a source of metrics.
experimentName: Augmentation transfer experiment — s0 matched to the short evaluation prompts
designOrigin: Phase 94 §13 item 1, adopted by Phase 95 §14 item 1
singleVariable: augmentation (enabled, k=8, s0 in [1,5]) — everything else pinned to the Phase 89/90/94 production recipe

baseline.label: baseline (k=0, no augmentation)
baseline.sourceNote: Phase 90 condition B, bit-identical per the Phase 90 reproducibility contract. Reused, not retrained, exactly as Phase 94 cell A did.

treatment.label: augment own-context k=8, s0 in [1,5]
treatment.sourceNote: Identical to Phase 94 cell B except AUG_S0_MIN 8 -> 1 and the new AUG_S0_MAX=5 cap. Init is bit-identical to Phase 94 cell B by construction (see initializationOrdering).

isolationReference.label: Phase 94 cell B (k=8, s0 in [8, 63-k]) — historical, NOT retrained
isolationReference.purpose: One-constant isolation: T vs B94 differs only in the s0 range. Reported as a secondary comparison; it is not the primary baseline.

recipe.objective: masked corrected 1-step causal CE (Phase 89), document-aligned layout (Phase 90)

augmentation.mechanism: Phase 94 §4.1 — true prefix x[0..s0] + model-own argmax tail (<= k, noGrad) + padding; CE targets are the TRUE document tokens aligned to the window
augmentation.s0EffectiveRule: min(AUG_S0_MAX, blockSize-1-k, docLen-2-k); AUG_S0_MAX=5 is the Phase 96 change
augmentation.rNote: Every 4th optimizer step uses augmented windows (step % 4 === 3). Unchanged from Phase 94.

initializationOrdering.claim: The treatment arm's initial weights are bit-identical to Phase 94 cells B and C.
initializationOrdering.mechanism: buildModel() does not call Random.setSeed. A model built immediately after buildTokenizer() sits at the same global-RNG stream position Phase 94's cells B and C did. DataLoader/BatchSampler shuffle is isolated (Random.seededShuffle) and does not consume the global stream.
initializationOrdering.verification: probe.ts --stage=preflight reproduces Phase 94's recorded initialLoss 5.977156484441439 exactly.
initializationOrdering.knownWart: Phase 94 §12.5 / §13.4 recommend Random.setSeed(SEED) inside buildModel. DELIBERATELY NOT FIXED in Phase 96: fixing it would change the init and break the one-constant isolation against Phase 94 cell B. Recorded, not silently changed.
initializationOrdering.reseedIsProvenNoop: probe.ts calls Random.setSeed(SEED) before the official buildModel (the Phase 90/94 fresh-run convention). This is a PROVEN no-op: BPETokenizer contains no reference to Random at all (grep-verified), so buildTokenizer() sets the stream origin and consumes nothing. A first-50-weights hash of the model built with and without the reseed is identical, and preflight independently reproduces 5.977156484441439. The reseed therefore cannot perturb the init.

baselineInitVariance.finding: The mandated baseline arm A is NOT init-matched to the treatment arm.
baselineInitVariance.evidence: Phase 94 candidate-A.json records cell A training.initialLoss = 6.0273 (that value is Phase 90's own recorded initial loss). Phase 94 cell B and Phase 96 arm T both re-derive 5.977156484441439 via --stage=preflight.
baselineInitVariance.consequence: A vs T therefore varies initialization AND augmentation together, so it is not a clean single-variable contrast. B94 vs T is the only init-matched one-constant comparison available in this experiment.
baselineInitVariance.handling: The baseline is kept exactly as mandated (Phase 94-defined, reused not retrained, per §5). The confound is disclosed in PHASE96-TRANSFER-EXPERIMENT-REPORT.md rather than corrected, because correcting it would require retraining the baseline and would redefine the frozen Phase 94/95 baseline.
baselineInitVariance.discoveredBy: inspection of Phase 94 candidate-A.json during the run; no experimental condition was altered as a result

evaluation.strictUtf8Role: historical / diagnostic only — never the primary decision
evaluation.rolloutMetric: greedy argmax next-token accuracy vs the true document, 60 docs x 24 steps (re-derived, Phase 94 probe.ts:933 algorithm)

endpoints.primary: Phase-95 repaired capability level (tolerant UTF-8 gate)

repetition.strategy: one deterministic seed (42), one official run — reported as a one-run experiment
repetition.reproDeterminismCheck: 2 x fresh 2-epoch runs with Random.setSeed(42) reset before each, per the Phase 90/94 convention. This is a determinism check, NOT statistical replication.
repetition.confidenceIntervals: not applicable — none are computed or claimed
